newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Magician sets up bottle making venture.
newsitem.headline: Magician sets up bottle making venture.

text.p: Magician Industries (Holdings) Ltd said on Wednesday it would set up a 51-percent owned plastic bottle manufacturing joint venture in Xian, capital of China's Shaanxi province.

Magician said in a statement the joint venture Xian Great East Packaging Co would involve a total investment of about US$4 million in which Magician would fund its share of investment by bank borrowings and internal resources.

Xian Great East, a joint veture with Magician business partner Glory Success International Ltd, will supply plastic bottles for Coca-Cola's bottling plants and other customers in China, the statement said.
Magician is a general houseware maker.
